draft_en.subject: Industrial PoE switch prices from ISAF
draft_en.body:
Hi Necdet,

We met at ISAF 2025 in Istanbul last October - this picks up what we discussed at the booth.

The industrial PoE switches you asked for: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, model STI-288GP - $59.8 USD EXW; 4 x PoE + 1 x SFP, model STI-144GP - $35.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS).

One question: if you send me your company name and the quantity, I will issue a formal quotation - how many units is the first project?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
